spans.text: In 1966, the Marxist South-West Africa People's Organization (SWAPO) guerrilla group launched a war of independence for the area that became Namibia, but it was not until 1988 that South Africa agreed to end its administration in accordance with a UN peace plan for the entire region.
Namibia gained independence in 1990, and SWAPO has governed it since, although the party has dropped much of its Marxist ideology.
